_comment: Speeds keep a 30:20:18:35:22 ratio, scaled so a Scooter 10 sails Rome-Tunis in about 60 s. range_nm is the longest single leg the model can sail (Scooter 10: 1 min 30 s of sailing, GE 100: 3 min 30 s, Greenline 200: 6 min, Trans Atlantic: Rome to New York, Dominator: 9,000 nm). max_owned is how many of each model the player can own. map_size (length, width in pixels) and map_color are how the ship is drawn on the map. fuel_tank is in fuel units; fuel_per_s is burned every second at sea, whatever the speed. Burn was set so fuel cost about a third of a leg's pay at full speed (about 40% since the fuel price rose 20%), and tanks are sized so a ship leaving at 100% maintenance can just finish a range_nm leg (plus 1 s spare) while wearing and slowing on the way. The Mammoth (recovery: true) sails no routes: it recovers lost ships, costs the most to run, and range_nm is the longest recovery job it can do. wear_pct_per_min is maintenance lost per minute of running at sea (the Dominator and Mammoth wear at half rate; speed is top speed x maintenance, so a ship at 0% stops); repair_cost_per_pct is set so repairs cost about 10% of what the ship earns sailing. dock_s is how long a ship unloads and loads at each port; repair, then refuel, each take refill_phase_s of that time.
